title: Technical Article Image Specification
description: Tool-agnostic specification for generating images (hero, illustration, section opener) for technical articles. Produced by the technical-writer skill in Visuals mode; consumed by image generators (DALL-E, Midjourney, Imagen, Stable Diffusion) or pasted into Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini for image generation.

purpose.description: What this image is for in the article. e.g. 'Hero image for blog post titled X', 'Section opener for the Y section'.

context.description: One sentence on the article's topic so the generator understands the surrounding piece.

subject.description: The literal thing in the frame. Concrete, not metaphorical. e.g. 'An isometric illustration of two parallel pipelines'.

style.description: Art-direction descriptor. e.g. 'minimal isometric tech illustration', 'editorial watercolor', 'soft pastel illustration'.

color_palette.description: Hex color codes the generator should respect. 2–6 colors typical.

aspect_ratio.description: Image aspect ratio. Common values: 16:9 (hero / OG card), 4:3, 3:2, 1:1, 3:1 (narrow band).

include.description: Specific elements that must be in the image.

exclude.description: Elements to keep out of the image. Almost always includes 'text', 'logos', 'watermarks'.

mood.description: One or two adjectives describing the emotional tone. e.g. 'calm, technical', 'investigative, slightly wry', 'energetic, precise'.

alt_text.description: Accessibility description for the rendered image. Present-tense, describes what's shown rather than what it represents. ≤125 characters preferred.

tools_supported.description: Which generators this spec has been tested on or is expected to work with.

lighting.description: Optional: lighting direction / quality. e.g. 'soft natural', 'dramatic side-light', 'studio flat'.

composition.description: Optional: how elements arrange in the frame. e.g. 'rule of thirds', 'centered subject', 'two horizontal bands'.

negative_prompt.description: Optional: explicit negative prompt for Stable Diffusion / Flux. Often subsumed by 'exclude' for other tools.

seed.description: Optional: reproducibility seed. Useful for iterating on a single composition.

reference_images.description: Optional: URLs or local paths to images the generator should use as visual references.

iteration_notes.description: What to tweak if the first generation doesn't land. Concrete adjustments tied to specific elements of the spec.

platform_hints.description: Optional: tool-specific overrides if the spec needs to render differently per generator.

examples.purpose: Hero image (lede + OG card) for a blog post titled 'Why caching at the agent harness beats caching at the model'
examples.context: Technical deep-dive on agent infrastructure latency. The argument is that the harness layer is a better cache boundary than the model API.
examples.subject: An isometric illustration of two parallel pipelines, one labelled 'harness' with a glowing cache layer, one labelled 'model' without. The harness pipeline has clearly faster particle flow.
examples.style: minimal isometric tech illustration, clean line art with selective gradient fills
examples.alt_text: Isometric illustration comparing two pipelines, with the cached harness pipeline showing faster data flow than the uncached model pipeline.
examples.composition: two horizontal bands, harness on top
examples.iteration_notes: If the cache layer doesn't read as a 'box', swap for a glowing torus shape. If particle flow looks like rain, switch to a directional gradient streak.
